Profile Rosemary (Rosmarinus officinalis, Lamiaceae) has rubefacient and mild analgesic activity when applied topically, and is includ- ed in external preparations for rheumatic and circulatory disor- ders. It is also reported to have carminative, spasmolytic, and di- uretic effects and is included in herbal preparations for gastrointestinal, cardiovascular, and urinary-tract disorders. Rosemary is a source of rosemary oil (below). Preparations Proprietary Preparations (details are given in Part 3) Braz.: Alrinte.
